topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Rain’s not the only thing soaked through to the bone tonight. I’m parked across from a quiet cul-de-sac, the kind where folks oughta feel safe. But someone’s got a screw loose. They towed a car right out of its own driveway. Ain’t no sign of a break-in, no note, nothing. The street’s empty, but you can bet someone’s watching. I bet they’re hunkered down, thinking they’re untouchable. Well, the night’s young, and the city’s full of secrets. I’m wagering this one’s about to spill.
